content.text: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction exists anywhere in the agreement. Section 3's restrictions are confined to use, copying and transfer of the licensed Work; Section 19 is a mutual non-solicit of employees, not a non-compete; Section 20 and the confidentiality provisions contain nothing restricting our business.

input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use covenant binding Sparkling, which meets the preferred position (no restriction on the businesses we operate or the products we buy or build). Section 3 ("RESTRICTIONS ON USE") is limited to conventional licence-scope restrictions on the Software and Documentation — no copying, no reverse engineering, no assignment or sublicence, and "not use the Work except as authorized herein" — none of which limits our freedom to acquire, develop or use competing routing software. Section 19 is a mutual one-year non-solicitation of employees (a separate category, and reciprocal rather than one-sided against us), and Section 20 and the confidentiality provisions in Section 14 impose no restrictive covenant; Section 14(c) in fact preserves independent development as a carve-out. Searches for "compet", "develop", "exclusiv", field-of-use and territory language returned no restriction on our business. No redline required.
